# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis artifacts generated during assessment.

1. **[architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md)** — High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
2. **[dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md)** — Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
3. **[api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md)** — API endpoints and service communication contracts.
4. **[data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md)** — Data model, persistence behavior, and sensitivity notes.
5. **[configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md)** — Configuration sources, properties, and runtime settings.
6. **[business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md)** — Core business processes and decision logic.
